purpose: Relevé du web actuel pour report fidèle dans Figma ; ne constitue ni nouvelle direction artistique ni acceptation utilisateur.

verification.method: Inspection des fichiers sources locaux et calculs géométriques depuis CSS. Aucun navigateur ni mutation Figma par cet agent.
limitations: Les positions de texte, hauteurs line-height:normal, positions des repères et rayon apparent de la sphère doivent être mesurés dans le navigateur actif.
Les nombres CSS sous-pixel et les dimensions clientWidth/clientHeight arrondies utilisées par MapLibre sont distingués.
Les traductions pays sont obtenues par Intl.DisplayNames de Node ; vérifier si la version ICU du navigateur diffère.

markerAppearance.direction: ltr even within RTL layout; label dir=auto

figmaStrategy: Use the same corrected campus JSON and derive 30 world country centroids; create named editable marker components only for visible front-side positions.

For pixel-accurate geography, export the actual prepared MapLibre canvas at each target viewport/theme with the camera above, or use exactly the same perspective projection. Raster geography can sit below editable UI and markers.
Keep light/dark map assets or matching theme-aware vector fills. Static map screenshots cannot inherit Figma colour variables automatically.

Keep all58 corrected campus coordinates as technical source data; country and campus states can be illustrated with selected destinations, without falsely claiming live globe rotation or MapLibre availability in Figma.
Do not mirror coastline SVGs, logo, geographic marker positions, or letters in RTL. Mirror only interface composition.

motion.reducedMotion: CSS animations/transitions disabled; JS respects prefers-reduced-motion.

implementationNotes: The welcome source is the latest standalone prototype, not production application.
The Figma v9 token snapshot alone is insufficient: welcome.css overrides light background, surfaces, muted text, active menu and dimensions.
At initial world level the back arrow is hidden and zoom-out is disabled at minimum zoom.
Profile popup content reflects visitor/member simulation; there is no real account.
Clean Explore home keeps content sheet hidden. Do not add project cards to the initial home.
